title: Type it once, it plans itself
caption:
Type it once. It plans itself ✏️

Write the day and time in the title, like “tomorrow 3pm dentist”, and Daily Charm sets them for you.

Daily Charm is free to start on iPhone and Android. Search “Daily Charm” on the App Store or Google Play.
